Direct answer

Is The Blood of Dawnwalker Multiplayer or Co-op?

Single-player confirmed

Official Bandai Namco material describes The Blood of Dawnwalker as a single-player action RPG. No co-op mode is promised in the sources checked.

Official positioning

The official cinematic trailer description calls the game a single-player open-world dark fantasy action RPG.

What that means for co-op

A single-player label is not evidence of hidden co-op. This page therefore does not claim local, online or campaign co-op support.

Future updates

If the publisher announces a new mode, this answer should change only after an official source is available.

This pre-release page separates official facts from unresolved questions. It will not invent hands-on results before the game is available.
